records.title: Did the Evidence Change the Answer?
records.provenance: Oren et al. arXiv v2 (November 24, 2023), ConStat NeurIPS 2024 and Xiao and Cheng arXiv v1 (2026); primary methods and limitations checked October 31, 2026. The 2026 preprint has an unreconciled displayed July 5 date and September-style identifier; no exact original-posting date is asserted.
records.evidenceLimits: Source-based analysis and an unperformed controlled comparison. No study reproduction, training-data audit, contamination test, model comparison or orchestration experiment was executed. Older but relevant: the 2023 and 2024 sources inform current evidence-use qualification; no current model or real investigation is qualified.
records.summary: A correct answer can demonstrate useful knowledge without demonstrating that the supplied evidence determined it. A proposed controlled comparison examines sensitivity to supplied evidence.

records.title: Validate the Association, Not Just the Extracted Value
records.provenance: Docling core snapshot 2dc4c9f511269eb39be5aad84b838f7bb179142e (commit October 29, 2026), Docling documentation snapshot 7b12671e1d324710e70784c18844d1d97522414f and PyMuPDF snapshot d2423b1367bcc9721ea7e994e710e5bc7ea91b09 (commits October 30). Sources checked October 30, 2026; snapshot dates are not stable-release or deployment dates.
records.evidenceLimits: Pinned source-code and documentation analysis with a proposed synthetic fixture. No parser, conversion, model-load roundtrip, benchmark, coordinate mutation or negative-control experiment was executed. Association-error frequency and source truth are not established.
records.summary: A parser can preserve a number and its bounding box while assigning it to the wrong column. The useful validation boundary is the relationship between the value, its source region, and its header.

records.title: Keeping the Agent Alive Is Not Finishing the Work
records.provenance: Official Copilot CLI 1.0.104 release notes, pinned changelog, command reference and Autopilot guide; public issue #5264 is explicitly unverified.
records.evidenceLimits: Official source inspection, one explicitly unverified public issue report and GhostMesh analysis. No runtime executed; the proposed comparison is unperformed. Performance, costs and account entitlement remain unknown.
records.summary: A small Copilot wait-rule change opens a larger question: how an agent keeps responsibility for unfinished work without mistaking a running process or an accepted handoff for a verified outcome.
